verdict.rationale: Cursor's security page says accounts can be deleted at any time from the Settings dashboard, which is a first-party deletion control covering Bugbot users. Privacy Mode is documented only as preventing training on your data, not as a retention control, so it gets no credit toward retention. missing for 10: configurable data retention periods, deletion of Bugbot-specific review data (PR diffs, comments, logs), documented retention policy for Bugbot-processed code, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Accounts can be deleted at any time from the Settings dashboard.
